item.title: Part 3: The Gravity Catalog
item.description: Not a new theory but a catalogue of everything we actually observe about gravity, from the smallest effects in our bones to the motion of galaxies: what gravity does, before deciding what it is. This episode is an AI-generated conversation made with Google NotebookLM from Shareef Ali Rashada's texts.

item.title: Part 5: Graviton Pressure Theory
item.description: Newton described gravity as attraction and Einstein as curvature, but neither said what gravity is made of. Part 5 sets out the graviton pressure mechanism. This episode is an AI-generated conversation made with Google NotebookLM from Shareef Ali Rashada's texts.

item.title: Part 6: Redefining Work
item.description: Holding up a bridge, suspending an object with a magnet, or keeping your arms raised count as zero work in classical physics. Part 6 treats them as continuous, active energy exchanges. This episode is an AI-generated conversation made with Google NotebookLM from Shareef Ali Rashada's texts.

item.title: Part 7: The Illusion of Pull
